components.name: Primary button
components.description: primary variant from src/components/ui.tsx and src/styles.css.
components.css: .ds-button { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:7px; min-height:36px; padding:8px 12px; border:1px solid #d5dfe1; border-radius:6px; font-family:"IBM Plex Sans",sans-serif; font-size:13px; font-weight:400; line-height:1.25; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 160ms ease,border-color 160ms ease,color 160ms ease; } .ds-button:hover:not(:disabled) { background:#eef3f3; border-color:#bdcdd0; } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #498896; outline-offset:4px; } .ds-button:disabled { cursor:not-allowed; opacity:.48; } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-button { transition-duration:.01ms; } } .ds-button { background:#20363b; color:var(--surface,#fff); border-color:#20363b; font-weight:500; } .ds-button:hover:not(:disabled) { background:#36535a; border-color:#36535a; }

components.name: Sidebar navigation
components.description: Selected route uses a quiet blue-grey fill and medium text.
components.html: OverviewALIBIGhost Access
components.css: .ds-nav { display:grid; gap:5px; font:13px "IBM Plex Sans",sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:11px; min-height:43px; padding:11px 12px; border-radius:7px; color:#586c73; text-decoration:none; transition:background-color 160ms ease,color 160ms ease; } .ds-nav a:hover { background:#e1e9eb; color:var(--ink,#1a2c31); } .ds-nav a[aria-current="page"] { background:#dfe7e9; color:var(--ink,#1a2c31); font-weight:500; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #498896; outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Room selector
components.description: Centered room tray with a white pressed state and equal phone buttons.
components.css: .ds-rooms { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:fit-content; max-width:100%; gap:3px; margin:0 auto; background:#eef2f2; border-radius:8px; padding:4px; } .ds-rooms button { border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:5px; padding:9px 18px; min-height:37px; background:none; color:var(--muted,#5d6b70); font:13px/1.2 "IBM Plex Sans",sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 160ms ease,color 160ms ease; } .ds-rooms button:hover { background:#e2e9e9; color:var(--ink,#1a2c31); } .ds-rooms button[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color:#dce4e5; background:var(--surface,#fff); color:var(--ink,#1a2c31); } .ds-rooms button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #498896; outline-offset:4px; } @media(max-width:740px) { .ds-rooms { width:100%; gap:2px; } .ds-rooms button { flex:1; padding:10px 0; min-height:39px; } }

components.name: Trust summary row
components.description: Flat module name and written state link; source src/views/Overview.tsx.
components.css: .ds-trust { width:100%; display:grid; grid-template-columns:125px minmax(0,1fr) 17px; gap:12px; align-items:center; padding:11px 0; border:0; background:var(--surface,#fff); text-align:left; color:var(--ink,#1a2c31); font:13px "IBM Plex Sans",sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-trust strong { font-weight:500; } .ds-trust span { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:9px; line-height:1.5; color:var(--muted,#5d6b70); } .ds-trust i { width:6px; height:6px; background:var(--positive,#35715c); border-radius:50%; } .ds-trust svg { color:#70878e; } .ds-trust:hover { background:#f7f9f9; } .ds-trust:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #498896; outline-offset:4px; } @media(max-width:740px) { .ds-trust { grid-template-columns:89px minmax(0,1fr) 14px; gap:8px; padding:12px 0; } }

narrative.overview:
The furnished architectural workspace makes device state understandable through a familiar home. Warm timber, cream walls, sage upholstery, and daylight belong to the interactive object; pale blue-grey chrome and a white work sheet give its controls a quiet, readable frame.

This is a compact operating interface. Plain language, restrained semantic colour, and progressively revealed evidence keep the home legible before its details are opened. The visual commitment is an original, useful furnished cutaway, with opaque controls and natural page scrolling.
keyCharacteristics: Pale architectural frame around a white work sheet.
Warm furnished home as an interactive object.
IBM Plex Sans controls with serif italic descriptive metadata.
Semantic status colour always paired with text.
Evidence and history revealed through explicit controls.

rules.name: The State Has Words Rule
rules.body: Status colour accompanies a written state; a coloured dot never carries the verdict alone.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: IBM Plex Sans carries headings, actions, and data values. Libre Baskerville italic carries descriptive metadata in sentence case with no tracking.

rules.name: The Flat Workspace Rule
rules.body: Resting controls and panels use tone and fine borders. Reserve ambient CSS shadow for modal separation; the house supplies its own physical depth.

dos: Do keep the house warm and furnished while keeping surrounding product controls pale and restrained.
Do retain the approved sidebar and centered room-selector arrangement on wide screens; adapt navigation to a labelled modal drawer on phones.
Do expose selection, state, and device actions in DOM controls as well as the canvas.
Do give short metadata a real serif italic voice, sentence case, and zero tracking; retain readable contrast backings over the scene.
Do pair evidence, access, and learning states with explicit text and preserve visible keyboard focus.
donts: Don't replace the approved workspace with terminal styling, gradients, decorative glass, or ambient visual effects.
Don't make colour the only way to distinguish supported, contradicted, warning, or neutral states.
Don't treat the current 11–12px metadata as a target for new primary controls or dense explanatory copy.
Don't move detailed device evidence or the full activity history into the default Overview state.
Don't present the browser simulation as live device security enforcement.
